title: Sameer Wankhede's Defamation Plea Against The Ba***ds Of Bollywood REJECTED By Delhi HC | Bollywood News - News18
text: In a big setback for Sameer Wankhede, the Delhi High Court on Thursday rejected the Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer’s plea accusing against Bollywood actor Shah Rukh Khan’s production house Red Chillies Entertainment Pvt Ltd and OTT platform Netflix over his alleged defamatory portrayal in the web series ‘The Ba**ds of Bollywood’. What Were Sameer Wankhede’s Allegations? Sameer Wankhede had filed a defamation suit seeking an injunction and the takedown of scenes in the Netflix series that allegedly ridicule him. The former NCB officer, who arrested actor Shah Rukh Khan’s son Aryan Khan in 2021 during a high-profile drug raid in Mumbai, was later cleared of all charges. In his plea, Wankhede claimed that one of the episodes in the series includes a man bearing a strong resemblance to him and that the depiction aims to tarnish his image. The suit sought ₹2 crore in damages from Red Chillies Entertainment, owned by actor Shah Rukh Khan and his wife Gauri Khan, and from Netflix. He had also requested an injunction restraining the publication or further dissemination of any defamatory statements related to him. About The Ba***ds Of Bollywood Ba***ds Of Bollywood marks the directorial debut of Shah Rukh Khan’s son Aryan Khan. The show stars Bobby Deol, Lakshya, Sahher Bambba, Manoj Pahwa, Mona Singh, Manish Chaudhari, Raghav Juyal, Anya Singh, Manoj Pahwa, and Vijayant Kohli, with Rajat Bedi and Gautami Kapoor. The series follows Aasmaan Singh (Lakshya), an ambitious outsider determined to carve a space in Bollywood. Along the way, he discovers the chaotic, glamorous, yet cutthroat nature of the industry. Created under the Red Chillies Entertainment banner, The Ba***ds Of Bollywood blends humour with drama in a self-aware, high-energy narrative. Netflix describes it as “the baddest, filmiest show on Earth," packed with cameos, thrills, and an adventurous dive into the film industry.
summary: In a big setback for Sameer Wankhede, the Delhi High Court on Thursday rejected the Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer’s plea accusing against Bollywood actor Shah Rukh Khan’s production house Red Chillies Entertainment Pvt Ltd and OTT platform Netflix over his alleged defamatory portrayal in the web series ‘The Ba**ds of Bollywood’. Sameer Wankhede had filed a defamation suit seeking an injunction and the takedown of scenes in the Netflix series that allegedly ridicule him.
